idea-plugin.name: Local Push Mock
idea-plugin.description:
Trigger local Android notifications on a device or emulator straight from the IDE — no backend, no web console and no Firebase Cloud Messaging credentials.

  • Compose title, body, channel, importance, deep link and data payload (JSON or key=value).
  • Detects connected devices and apps that include the debug companion library.
  • Mimics a real FCM notification: default icon, color and channel from your Firebase meta-data, and the data payload delivered as Intent extras on tap.
  • Optional hook to render the notification with your own production code.
  • Grants POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+ with one click.

How it works: the plugin sends an explicit broadcast through adb to a receiver that exists only in your debug build (debugImplementation) and is protected by the android.permission.DUMP permission, so other apps cannot trigger it and nothing ships to production.

Setup: add the debug companion library to your app, install the debug variant and open the Local Push tool window.

Documentation: for detailed, step-by-step setup and usage instructions, see the User Guide on GitLab.
